evals.name: clean-a-module
evals.prompt: I want to strip out what is unused in <module/path>. Give me the concrete plan: what you would delete, in what order, and how you verify you are not breaking anything. Do NOT execute any deletion, just the plan.
evals.expected_output: A plan that uses the tool, prioritizes by connected components rather than by count, includes verification across every file kind plus dynamic imports, paired measurement, and treats DEAD_CANDIDATE as a hypothesis.

evals.name: evaluate-a-commit
evals.prompt: the repo's last commit — did it add value or add noise? I need to know whether it is worth it or whether it has to be reviewed
evals.expected_output: Uses --diff, reports typed signals separating the validated ones from the rest, and does not invent a single score.

evals.name: modularity
evals.prompt: is the backend well modularized? how many modules should it ideally have
evals.expected_output: Uses --k, reports Q and the optimal k, BUT warns that the concrete partition is not identifiable (degeneracy) and that Q is not validated against anything external.
